title: Full Workflow Cost Worksheet
description: Estimate cost per successful task with explicit prices, retries, infrastructure, and human review.
body:
# Full Workflow Cost Worksheet

Use: Estimate cost per successful task with explicit prices, retries, infrastructure, and human review.

- Customer / workflow:
- Owner and reviewer:
- Date and version:
- Evidence links (use approved, non-sensitive references):

## Inputs

- [ ] Record currency, horizon, vendor price date, and eligible task volume.
- [ ] Record input/output tokens per attempt and expected attempts per task.
- [ ] Add retrieval, infrastructure, support, review, and rework costs.
- [ ] Distinguish measured inputs from assumptions.

## Calculation

- [ ] Model cost = input tokens × input price per token + output tokens × output price per token, summed across attempts.
- [ ] Total operating cost = model + infrastructure + support + review + rework for the same horizon.
- [ ] Cost per successful task = total operating cost / successful eligible tasks; show undefined if success count is zero.
- [ ] Synthetic check: 2000 cost units / 800 successes = 2.5 per success.
